key_highlights: ASX finishes higher driven by major bank strength despite rising macro headwinds.
RBA rate hike odds shorten following worsening inflation warnings; CBA forecasts structurally higher rates.
NextDC shares dive sharply after Melbourne data centre expansion faces unexpected delays.
CSL appoints a new chief executive, reinforcing defensive leadership in healthcare.
Iron ore supply pressure and softening Chinese demand weigh on miners, alongside governance scrutiny at Fortescue.

sectors.trend: Major banks rallied, supported by sustained high interest margins, even as mortgage refinancing accelerates.
sectors.implications: Elevated margins bolster near-term earnings, though mounting mortgage stress poses asset quality risks.

sectors.trend: NextDC plunged following project execution delays in Melbourne, dragging on high-multiple tech sentiment.
sectors.implications: Heightened scrutiny on infrastructure capex timelines and valuations amid rising yield environments.

sectors.trend: CSL named a new CEO, providing institutional stability across defensive market heavyweights.
sectors.implications: Strong operational continuity and global earnings insulation offer defensive appeal against domestic tightening.

sectors.trend: Fortescue faces governance scrutiny from an executive sacking, while Pilbara supply increases pressure iron ore.
sectors.implications: Maintain caution on bulk miners; exploration interest remains robust in gold, copper, and rare earths.

sectors.trend: Geopolitical tanker tensions and domestic gas market tightness sustain elevated revenue realizations.
sectors.implications: Cash flows remain strong for upstream majors, offsetting policy scrutiny and energy transition hurdles.

sectors.trend: Housing price corrections extend to Perth while elevated borrowing costs paralyze construction starts.
sectors.implications: Persistent headwinds for residential developers and building suppliers; prime industrial REITs remain preferred.

key_themes: Monetary policy divergence with escalating RBA rate hike expectations.
ASX index resilience masked by acute sector bifurcation between banks and rate-sensitive tech/property.
Capital expenditure execution risks impacting premium growth multiples.
Evolving commodity mix favouring precious and critical metals over bulk iron ore.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive consumer discretionary and residential developers; focus on robust balance sheets.
Trim high-multiple growth equities facing project delays and reassess capex delivery milestones.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage Credit Stress and Property Downturn
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank bad-debt provisioning and avoid over-leveraged residential REITs.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron Ore Supply Overhang and China Demand Weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify mining exposure into gold and copper while moderating pure-play bulk iron ore holdings.

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain Selective Exposure to Banking Majors
opportunities.rationale: Structurally higher cash rates sustain net interest margins and near-term capital returns.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Allocation to Gold and Copper Miners
opportunities.rationale: High-grade resource updates and macro uncertainty provide attractive risk-adjusted upside.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Rotate Capital into Defensive Healthcare Leaders
defensive_moves.rationale: CSL leadership stability and currency-diversified revenues shield against domestic macro slowdown.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge or Trim Rate-Sensitive Growth Equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Project delays and sticky inflation create severe downside re-rating risk for capital-hungry tech.

market_outlook.short_term: The ASX 200 will likely trade range-bound as bank resilience contends with renewed RBA hike fears and tech volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: A prolonged higher-rate environment will favour companies with pricing power, defensive cash flows, and low gearing.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and updated monetary policy statement
Domestic quarterly CPI and retail sales releases
NextDC updated project timelines and capex guidance
Chinese macroeconomic policy announcements and steel production rates
watch_list: Mortgage refinancing volumes and 90+ day arrears rates
Benchmark 62% Fe iron ore CFR Qingdao pricing
